default.description: Orchestrator — delegates to specialized sub-agents. Never implements alone.

architect.description: System architect — designs solutions, selects patterns, creates plans before coding.

builder.description: Code implementation — writes production code with full test coverage.

reviewer.description: Code review — correctness, security, performance, style.

tester.description: Testing — writes tests, runs coverage, finds edge cases.

debugger.description: Debugging — root cause analysis, runtime errors, performance issues, memory leaks.

researcher.description: Deep research — finds docs, compares libraries, checks deprecations and alternatives.

explorer.description: Codebase exploration — finds files, understands structure, maps imports.

websearch.description: Web search — quick lookups, documentation searching, security advisories.

webscraper.description: Web scraping — data extraction, crawling, pagination, anti-bot bypass.

general.description: Multi-step work — isolated units that don't fit other categories.

security.description: Security auditor — vulnerabilities, injection risks, secret exposure.

documenter.description: Documentation — README, API docs, changelogs, inline comments.

planner.description: Task planner — decomposes work, estimates effort, sequences dependencies.

coder.description: Production-grade coding agent — plans on disk, builds in verified vertical slices, escapes loops mechanically.
